# Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Route FCM and APNs push notifications to handlers and MAUI Shell screens. Does not register tokens.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-push-router
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Registration: `UsePushRouter` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I open a Shell page from an FCM / APNs tap in MAUI?
- Route push notifications by route or type
- Cold-start notification navigation

## Do not use when

- You need token registration or displaying system notifications — use Firebase / APNs in the host app
- The payload is only a deep link URI — consider Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
